sourceOwner: PagedText with existing complete UTF8 borrow and actual <=4096 payload/metadata pages
intrinsic: UTF8 at most128 bytes stays within the finite semantic wrapper
aliases: An immutable first-party reference-counted handle clones only its identity; it never duplicates or flattens payload pages
rootLayout: The implementation owns a declared private root layout and measures its exact Layout; no assumed std Arc private allocation layout
admission: Charge the exact root layout before allocation and preserve the actual input PagedText on every refused root admission/allocation
lastReference: A consuming explicit retirement operation atomically decrements the handle; a nonlast reference earns zero physical bytes; the unique final recipient moves the real PagedText out before deallocating the exact root and then drains real pages
drop: Dropping a live paged handle must not guess final-reference cleanup or recursively free pages; every actual caller must transfer or explicitly retire it
clone: No payload allocation, progress reset, admission refund or second contiguous owner
valueProjection: ToValue/FromValue transfer or clone semantic handles without creating a String; record/schema/canonical refusal scaffolds retain their actual aliases until explicit retirement
requiredCases: two aliases preserve exact borrowed source pointer and octets
nonlast retirement frees no root or payload
final recipient observes exact root layout and all actual pages
parallel consuming final retirement yields exactly one page recipient
root admission refusal preserves original source and pointer
successful typed result remains distinct from retired source/parse scaffold
canonical refusal retains all actual aliases and original pages
allCallerGate: Held until actual semantic fields, projection visitors, snapshot/native producers, DSL FieldValue/Value String alternatives, diff/inverse/undo/redo and every ordinary exit use the first-party source and explicit lifetime authority
